value.rationale: The restricted two-nonparallel-line family is a natural finite affine incidence class, different from unrestricted real two-line unions, finite projective-plane two-line unions, and pairs of parallel affine lines. Its exact order-four threshold has a geometric cause: q3 cross-matching directions must coincide, while q4 supplies a nonparallel pair and ample avoiding directions. It is an all-orders (including non-Desarguesian) classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or generic numeric upper bound. Known real-plane five bound is explicitly credited.
